conclusion: The gate passes on the merge commit: A passes in both its runs and B passes in both its runs, with no invalid run. No measured operation runs new code (ADR-034, G13 verification plan item 4), and sdk/kernel at d124a40 is byte-identical to that of b7071ed. The slow mode of the contended lease appears on both commits: 24 of 40 kernel windows at 8 and 32 callers on d124a40 and 21 of 40 on 17283a8. The highest owner Enter+Leave window p99 of any candidate is 1,665 ns on d124a40 and 1,633 ns on 17283a8, against 1,649 and 1,614 ns in ../callpath-full-g13-ab/ and below the 1,762 and 1,795 ns of ../callpath-full-merged-ab/. The difference between A and B lies within the spread of the slow mode that the section "2026-11-22 call-path gate on the merge commit" of ADR-034 describes, so the gate forces no kernel fix. This run closes item 4 of the G13 verification plan.
